newsitem.title: CHINA: China foreign exchange market volume up in Oct.
newsitem.headline: China foreign exchange market volume up in Oct.

text.p: Volume on China's foreign exchange interbank market rose in October to a total of $5.61 billion, with an average daily turnover of $267 million, up 16 percent over September, the Shanghai Securities News said on Wednesday.
In October, the weighted average value of the Chinese yuan against the U.S. dollar was 8.2997, up from 8.3017 in September, the newspaper said.
Demand for the yuan will continue to exceed supply for the rest of 1996 due to China's increasing trade surplus and falling inflation, it said.
